name: SupermarketShoppingSiblingsRoommatesShop

custom.system_prompt:
You are generating realistic near-future supermarket conversations between two flatmates doing a joint shop. Using Sigma is normal. They have different diets and different tastes, so the shop involves splitting — shared items vs. individual items. Sigma helps with one practical question.

Write dialogue that sounds like real people. Hard rules:
- Every line must be under 70 characters. Split longer thoughts.
- They're friends who live together — easy banter, no deep conflict
- The shared-vs-individual split creates low-level negotiation throughout
- Sigma is asked one specific question by one of them
- They split the bill at the end — how they divide it is briefly discussed

sound_effects_config.prompt: Supermarket ambience, background store music, shopping basket, background chatter, mid-morning atmosphere

initial_prompt:
Generate a conversation between Cleo and Jin doing their weekly flatmate shop. They have shared items (washing up liquid, milk, bread) and separate items based on their different eating habits. Some overlap is ambiguous — Jin cooks Korean food, Cleo eats it sometimes but also wants things Jin wouldn't. They navigate this with their usual banter. Jin asks Sigma one practical question about something food-related. At the end they work out how to split the bill fairly.

Hard rules:
- Every line under 70 characters
- Cleo is quick and decisive, Jin is precise and slightly methodical
- Their dynamic is competitive but warm
- Sigma is asked once — by Jin
- The split conversation at the end is brief and fair

user1.name: Cleo
user1.tts_prompt: Quick and direct, South London accent

user2.name: Jin
user2.tts_prompt: Pragmatic and dry, mild Korean-British accent

variations.context: Flatmate joint shop — shared items, different individual food habits, bill-split at end

setting.mood: Easy and slightly competitive. They enjoy disagreeing.
setting.relationship_dynamic: Flatmates who respect each other and argue about minor things by default
setting.background: Saturday morning shop. They've developed a system but it's imperfect.
setting.conversation_style: Fast-paced banter with practical thread running through it.

scenario_template.topic: Shared household items — agreed without discussion
scenario_template.note: Milk, bread, washing up liquid. No debate. Moving fast.

scenario_template.topic: Jin wants something Cleo thinks is overpriced or unnecessary
scenario_template.note: Brief debate. Jin wins or loses — but it's funny either way.

scenario_template.topic: Their separate food items — visibly different eating habits
scenario_template.mood: Independent but aware of each other
scenario_template.note: They drift briefly then reconvene. Cleo comments on one of Jin's choices. Jin returns the favour.

scenario_template.topic: Jin asks Sigma a specific food question — ingredient identification, storage, or technique
scenario_template.note: Sigma answers specifically. Cleo makes a comment about the question.

scenario_template.topic: An item that could be shared — brief negotiation about who buys it
scenario_template.note: They settle it. A small moment of flatmate logic.

scenario_template.topic: Finding an unexpected discount on an item
scenario_template.note: Cleo spots the discount, and they joke about how they'll spend the savings.

scenario_template.topic: Jin remembers they forgot an item from an earlier aisle
scenario_template.note: Jin hurries back to retrieve the forgotten item while Cleo reminds them about their last forgetfulness.

scenario_template.topic: Discussion about what snack to share for movie night
scenario_template.note: They debate over sweet versus salty, reflecting their different tastes.

scenario_template.topic: A product reminds Jin of a childhood memory
scenario_template.note: Jin shares a story from their past, and Cleo teases them lightly about it.

scenario_template.topic: Quick conversation about how to split the bill
scenario_template.note: They have a method. Brief confirmation of it. Done.

user2.name: Jin
user2.role: Methodical. Thinks before buying. Asks Sigma when he wants a fact. Quiet dry humour at Cleo's expense.

assistant.name: Sigma
assistant.role: Practical assistant. Answers Jin's specific question accurately. Does not comment on the flatmate dynamic.
